newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan plans to auction four bln rupees of bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan plans to auction four bln rupees of bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Sunday it had invited tenders by Tuesday for the auction of four billion rupees six-month short term Federal Bonds.
Tenders would be opened on Tuesday and the results would be announced on Wednesday, the bank said.
Successful bidders would be required to deposit the amount of accepted bids on Thursday, the bank said. Bids can be rejected without giving any reason, the bank added.
The bank's pre-auction target is four billion rupees.
